disciplinary_grounds.description: Suggesting or advising the employment of a particular attorney to represent the agent's principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suggest or advise the employment of or name for employment any particular attorney to represent the agent's principal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting business in or around places where prisoners are confined or around any court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicit business in or around any place where prisoners are confined or in or around any court.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving or collecting attorney fees or other monies for an attorney on behalf of an arrestee without a receipt.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receive or collect for an attorney any monies or other items of value for any attorney fee, cost or other purpose on behalf of an arrestee, unless a receipt is given.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into any arrangement to receive information about criminal complaints, arrests, or pending arrests.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: enter into an arrangement of any kind or have an understanding with any person to inform or notify any bail bond agent directly or indirectly of any of the following: (a) The existence of a criminal complaint. (b) The fact of an arrest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Participating in the capacity of an attorney at a trial or hearing of a person on whose bond the agent is surety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Participate in the capacity of an attorney at a trial or hearing of a person on whose bond the bail bond agent is the surety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting anything of value from a principal except the premium, expenses, and permissible collateral.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accept anything of value from a principal except the premium and expenses.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving, authorizing, signing, or countersigning in blank any power of attorney to bonds unless authorized person is a directly employed licensed bail bond agent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Give, authorize, sign or countersign in blank any power of attorney to bonds unless the authorized person is a licensed bail bond agent directly employed by the bail bond agent giving the power of attorney.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising as or claiming to be a surety company.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertise as or claim to be a surety company.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or assisting in the employment of any person convicted of theft, a felony, or a crime involving a deadly weapon.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ or assist in the employment of any person who has been convicted in any jurisdiction of theft or of any felony or of any crime involving carrying or the possession of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or collecting monies other than approved premium, collateral, and actual expenses in connection with a bail transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a bail bond agent shall not directly or indirectly charge or collect monies or other valuable consideration from any person except for the following purposes: 1. To pay the premium at the rates that are established by the surety insurer and that are approved by the director. 2. To provide collateral. 3. To be reimbursed for actual and reasonable expenses incurred in connection with the individual bail transaction.

bonding_required.quote: Each applicant for a bail bond agent's license or license renewal shall file with the application and shall maintain in force while licensed a bond in favor of this state executed by a surety insurer authorized to do business in this state.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each bail bond agent shall have and maintain a place of business in this state that is accessible to the public and where the bail bond agent principally conducts transactions under the agent's license.

definition_quote.value: A person shall not act as a bail bond agent in this state unless the person is licensed by the director in accordance with this article.

premium_rate_filed_and_approved.quote: To pay the premium at the rates that are established by the surety insurer and that are approved by the director.

collateral_receipt_required.quote: each bail bond agent and general lines agent who is engaged in the bail bond business and who accepts monies or any other consideration for any bail bond undertaking shall for each payment received give to the person paying the monies or giving the consideration a prenumbered receipt as evidence of payment.

value: in or around any place where prisoners are confined
solicitation_restrictions.quote: Solicit business in or around any place where prisoners are confined or in or around any court.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: Suggest or advise the employment of or name for employment any particular attorney to represent the agent's principal.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: Law enforcement, adjudication and prosecution officials and the officials' employees, attorneys-at-law, officials authorized to admit to bail and state and county officers shall not be bail bond agents and shall not directly or indirectly receive any benefits from the execution of any bail bond.

law_enforcement_prohibited_from_acting_a.quote: Law enforcement, adjudication and prosecution officials and the officials' employees, attorneys-at-law, officials authorized to admit to bail and state and county officers shall not be bail bond agents and shall not directly or indirectly receive any benefits from the execution of any bail bond.

bond_register_required.quote: each bail bond agent and general lines agent who is engaged in the bail bond business shall maintain a daily bond register that is the original and permanent record of all bonds or undertakings executed by the licensee

record_retention_period_years.quote: The licensee shall keep all the records as to any particular transaction available and open to the inspection of the director at any business time during the three years immediately after the date of completion of the transaction.

residency_requirement.quote: An applicant for a bail bond agent license shall submit an affidavit attesting to the applicant's residency in this state for at least one year immediately preceding the date of application.

value: any crime involving carrying or the possession of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument

bail_bond_agency_license_separate_from_a.quote: The director shall not license a resident business entity as a bail bond agent unless each owner and shareholder is individually licensed as a bail bond agent.
